verdict.rationale: AWS documents that new Free Tier accounts get $100 in credits immediately and can earn up to $100 more. That is up to $200 over 6 months, with no charges unless you convert to a Paid plan, so both the credit limits and the expiry are spelled out. A community comment also references a free egress allowance. Missing for 10: documented per-service always-free tier limits, a published startup-credits program (e.g., for funded startups) with its terms, and independent hands-on corroboration of the Free plan's no-charge guarantee.
